mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a softer technique than EI, ions being produced by collisions between sample molecules and ions generated by reagent gas such as methane or ammonia."

Chemical Ionisation (CI) Chemical ionisation (CI) is a softer technique than EI, ions being produced by collisions between sample molecules and ions generated by reagent gas such as methane or ammonia.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of the electronic rotational and vibrational energy changes."
The total energy change is the sum of the electronic rotational and vibrational energy changes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a useful calibration sample to check the performance of an IR spectrometer."
Polystyrene is a useful calibration sample to check the performance of an IR spectrometer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to collide with it so that their energies are reduced to <10 eV."
A reagent gas is used to collide with it so that their energies are reduced to <10 eV.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in mass spectrometry such as electron impact (EI), chemical ionisation (CI), fast atom bombardment (FAB) and electrospray (ESI) ionisation techniques."
Various types of ionisation techniques are used in mass spectrometry such as electron impact (EI), chemical ionisation (CI), fast atom bombardment (FAB) and electrospray (ESI) ionisation techniques.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mass spectroscopic technique in which the analyte reacts with ions of a reagent gas."
CI-MS is a mass spectroscopic technique in which the analyte reacts with ions of a reagent gas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the normal electron configuration predicted from the „rules‟ for filling a many-electron atom."
The ground state is the normal electron configuration predicted from the „rules‟ for filling a many-electron atom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a scalar property, meaning that it can be either positive (+ symbol) or negative (- symbol)."
Charge is a scalar property, meaning that it can be either positive (+ symbol) or negative (- symbol).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as materials composed of molecules or atoms or ions."
Matter is defined as materials composed of molecules or atoms or ions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for impurity identification in pharmaceutical industry."
GC-MS is used for impurity identification in pharmaceutical industry.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a saturated straight chain so the spectra is characterised by clusters of peaks 14 mass units (CH2 groups) apart, as successive C-C bonds along the chain are cleaved in different molecules."
Octane is a saturated straight chain so the spectra is characterised by clusters of peaks 14 mass units (CH2 groups) apart, as successive C-C bonds along the chain are cleaved in different molecules.

useful application of Raman spectrometry
useful application of Raman spectrometry is the detection of groups that have very weak absorbances in the infrared region, such as substituted alkynes.
______ is a form of energy and we are constantly reminded of its presence via our sense of sight and ability to feel radiant heat.
Radiation
Radiation is a form of energy and we are constantly reminded of its presence via our sense of sight and ability to feel radiant heat.
______ is a technique to generate ions for mass spectrometry using electrospray by applying a high voltage to a liquid to produce an aerosol.
Electrospray ionization (ESI)
Electrospray ionization
ESI
Electrospray ionization (ESI) is a technique to generate ions for mass spectrometry using electrospray by applying a high voltage to a liquid to produce an aerosol.
______ are the photomultiplier, the electron multiplier and the micro-channel plate detectors.
more common ones
The more common ones are the photomultiplier, the electron multiplier and the micro-channel plate detectors.
______ refers to the analysis of the interaction of a molecule with infrared light.
Infrared Spectroscopy generally
Infrared Spectroscopy generally refers to the analysis of the interaction of a molecule with infrared light.

Desorption Techniques
Desorption Techniques Desorption Techniques are used mainly for solid samples that can be deposited on the tip of a heat able probe that is then inserted into the sample inlet through vacuum locks.
______ is the study of the interaction of light with matter.
Spectroscopy
Spectroscopy is the study of the interaction of light with matter.
______ is a shift to higher wavelength, while hypsochromic shift is a shift lower wavelength and hyperchromic shift is a shift to stronger absorbance.
Bathochromic shift
Bathochromic shift is a shift to higher wavelength, while hypsochromic shift is a shift lower wavelength and hyperchromic shift is a shift to stronger absorbance.

principles
The principles are the same in a Fourier transform IR instrument except that the monochromator is replaced by an interferometer.
______ is a powerful technique for the characterisation of the exact structure of compounds.
Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy
Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy is a powerful technique for the characterisation of the exact structure of compounds.
